difference.q: How is an AI orchestrator different from an ordinary chatbot?
difference.a: A chatbot follows a script. An orchestrator understands the task, picks the right model or agent, calls your systems and takes actions — with control and a log of every step.

launch.q: How long does a launch take?
launch.a: A pilot on one scenario usually takes 2–4 weeks. A full rollout depends on the number of channels and integrations.

channels.a: Telegram, WhatsApp, LINE, WeChat, Instagram, VK, Viber, Facebook Messenger, email, a website widget and an SDK for mobile apps. Others — via API.

languages.q: Which languages does the agent speak?
languages.a: More than 30 languages with auto-detection. Operators can reply in their own language — translation is automatic.

unknown.q: What if the agent doesn't know the answer?
unknown.a: It doesn't make things up: it tells the customer honestly and hands the conversation to an operator with a summary and history.

data.q: Where is the data stored? Can we avoid external clouds?
data.a: Yes. Deployment inside your perimeter with local models is possible — data never leaves your infrastructure.

models.q: Which AI models do you use?
models.a: We choose them for the task: OpenAI, Anthropic, Qwen, Grok or open-source models. The orchestrator lets you combine and switch them without rebuilding the system.

crm.q: Do you integrate with our CRM or ERP?
crm.a: Yes — with popular systems out of the box, and with the rest via API.

measure.a: Before we start, we agree on metrics — response time, share of requests resolved without an operator, conversion, request handling time — and report on them regularly.

start.q: What do you need from us to get started?
start.a: A description of the task, access to a knowledge base or sample requests, and a contact person. We take care of the rest.

teamLanguages.q: Which languages do you work with clients in?
teamLanguages.a: The website and communication are available in English, Russian, French, German, Japanese, Chinese and Thai.
